notes.subject: Shilo
notes.rationale: she-lo ay-kah-ah she-lo-ha-loo to Shiloh (the place) vs 'until he comes' vs 'until his come / tribute come' — three ancient readings of שילה.

notes.subject: עד כי
notes.rationale: 'until (ki) Shiloh come' vs 'as long as men come to Shiloh' (JPS) — the function of כי is disputed.

notes.subject: shevet/mechoqeq
notes.rationale: scepter-and-lawgiver pairing, a ruling staff plus the one who engraves decrees, lost as plain nouns.

notes.subject: Shilo
notes.rationale: the verse is deliberately opaque — an epithet whose meaning is withheld from the first hearer.

notes.subject: yiqqehat ammim
notes.rationale: 'obedience of peoples' (ASV, YLT) rendered here as 'tumelano ya ditshaba' (allegiance), following the root יקה 'to obey/align oneself'.

translation: Setlhako se sa tla se ikgaoge go Yudahe, le mothehi wa melao go magareng ga dinao tsa gagwe, go fitlha Shilo a tsena; mme go ene ke tumelano ya ditshaba.
